note: Default values. The web app copies these into MongoDB on first start; after that, prices are edited from the app's Prices screen.

tariff_residential.source: NEPRA decision 12 Jan 2026 (A-1 residential), as quoted by bill.com.pk, lesco-online.com.pk, ebillpakistan.com. Not checked against the official NEPRA PDF.
tariff_residential.unprotected_rule: all units charged at the rate of the slab the month falls in

calibration.source: unprotected_multiplier: median of 36 real monthly bills (data/bill_history_amounts.csv); protected and tax: 7 bills with full breakdown (data/bill_charges.csv)

net_billing.source: Profit by Pakistan Today, 10 Feb 2026: NEPRA (Prosumer) Regulations 2026, buyback Rs 11 per unit for new consumers. Other sites quote Rs 8.13 to 13.
net_billing.old_net_metering_contracts: Agreements signed before 9 Feb 2026 keep old terms until expiry

panel_per_watt.source: pakistansolarprices.com (4 Nov 2026: Longi Hi-MO 7 580W Rs 42/W, Jinko Rs 37 to 43/W), zell.pk (Oct 2026: Rs 39 to 43.5/W)

panel_watt.source: common size in the same listings

inverter_hybrid_per_kw.source: 6 kW about Rs 215k to 245k, 10 kW about Rs 395k to 425k (cncelectric.pk, solarhubofficial.com, mid 2026)

structure_normal_per_kw.source: GI/aluminium frame Rs 28k to 40k for 5 kW, Rs 55k for 6 kW (solarpricepakistan.com.pk, enontraders.com)

structure_elevated_per_kw.source: ESTIMATE, no source for elevated frames

min_inverter_kw.source: smallest common grid-tied/hybrid inverter size in the price lists

fixed_costs.source: ESTIMATE: net billing application, bidirectional meter, transport, small parts

solar.yield_source: Jan to Oct 2026 measured on H003 (10 kW, Lahore). Nov and Dec are ESTIMATES until measured.
solar.life_source: ESTIMATE: typical inverter warranty/life 10 to 15 years, lithium battery 8 to 12 years
